_about: Caspar Olevianus (1536-1587), co-author with Ursinus of the Heidelberg Catechism: An Exposition of the Symbole of the Apostles, translated out of the Latin (London, 1581; the translator is John Field, by the catalogue). Elizabethan and Stuart English translations, as Early English Books Online scans on the Internet Archive; raw OCR of 16th- and 17th-century type (blackletter in places), poor in places. Internet Archive OCR, raw and unconverted; each title page read before listing.
